import json, random, sys, time
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
from harness import call
from ebpf.create_dfa import create, registry_columns

names=['S%02d'%i for i in range(16)]
reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
cols,colmap=registry_columns(reg)
rng=random.Random(7)

def timed(label, text):
    t=time.time()
    try:
        img=create(text,cols,colmap)
        print('%-34s rows=%-6d cells=%-7d %.2fs'%(label,len(img.rows),img.cells,time.time()-t))
    except Exception as e:
        print('%-34s %-12s %.2fs'%(label,type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)[:20],time.time()-t))

# (a) random words length 4 -> big trie, under the row cap
words=set()
while len(words)<2000: words.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(4)))
timed('2000 random words len4',' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in words))
# (b) 4096 words length 16 == full path budget -> rejected
words=set()
while len(words)<4096: words.add(tuple(rng.choice(names) for _ in range(16)))
p=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in words)
print('policy chars', len(p))
timed('4096 random words len16 (reject)',p)
# (c) all sequences of length 3 -> heavy merging
allw=[(a,b,c) for a in names for b in names for c in names]
timed('4096 all words len3',' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in allw))
# (d) contains-heavy products
timed('contains x4 + match', '(contains(S00,S01) and contains(S02,S03) and endswith(S04) and startswith(S05)) allow; match(S06) drop;')
timed('endswith len4', 'endswith(S00,S01,S02,S03) allow;')
timed('all sequences len2 drop', 'contains() allow; '+' '.join('match(%s,%s) drop;'%(a,b) for a in names for b in names))
# (e) 16 stages of a mid-size policy in one request
mid=' '.join('match(%s) allow;'%','.join(w) for w in list(words)[:600])
ev=[{'op':'stage','epoch':i+1,'policy':mid} for i in range(16)]
j={'services':reg,'limits':{'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192},'events':ev}
data=json.dumps({'jobs':[j]},separators=(',',':'))
t=time.time(); out,raw=call(data); dt=time.time()-t
r=out['results'][0]['events']
print('16 stages of %d atoms: %.2fs ok=%s outbytes=%d'%(600,dt,sum(1 for x in r if x.get('ok')),len(raw)))
PYEOF
time python3 perf1.py
